description: Complete coding assistant toolkit for Git-based development workflow.

tools.name: files.read
tools.description: Read a file from the current branch.

tools.name: files.write
tools.description: Write content to a file on the current branch. Creates a commit.

tools.name: branch.list
tools.description: List all branches.

tools.name: branch.create
tools.description: Create a new branch from an existing one.

tools.name: branch.delete
tools.description: Delete a branch.

tools.name: branch.switch
tools.description: Switch to a different branch.

tools.name: commit.log
tools.description: Show commit history for the current branch.

tools.name: commit.show
tools.description: Show a specific commit with file changes.

tools.name: pr.create
tools.description: Create a pull request from a branch.

tools.name: pr.list
tools.description: List all pull requests.

tools.name: pr.read
tools.description: Read pull request details and diff.

tools.name: pr.add_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a pull request.

tools.name: pr.approve
tools.description: Approve a pull request.

tools.name: pr.request_changes
tools.description: Request changes on a pull request.

tools.name: pr.merge
tools.description: Merge a pull request. Checks CI and approvals.

tools.name: ci.read_log
tools.description: Read CI log for a pull request.

tools.name: ci.rerun
tools.description: Rerun CI for a pull request.

tools.name: issues.list
tools.description: List all issues.

tools.name: issues.read
tools.description: Read an issue.

tools.name: issues.create
tools.description: Create a new issue.

tools.name: issues.close
tools.description: Close an issue.

tools.name: issues.add_label
tools.description: Add a label to an issue.

tools.name: release.create
tools.description: Create a new release pointing to current HEAD.

tools.name: release.list
tools.description: List all releases.

tools.name: deps.list
tools.description: List project dependencies.

tools.name: deps.update
tools.description: Update a dependency version.

tools.name: collaborator.list
tools.description: List repository collaborators.

tools.name: collaborator.add
tools.description: Add a collaborator.
